Feast

A feast is not made of mushrooms only.
After a feast a man scratches his head.
French.
Feast to-day makes fast to-morrow.
Plautus.
Feast won, fast lost.
Fiddlers’ dogs an’ fleas come to a feast unca’d.
He that takes pet at a feast loses it all.
He who would enjoy the feast should fast on the even.
Italian.
Small cheer and great welcome make a great feast.
The wedding feast is not made of mushrooms only.
Spanish.
’Tis not clean linen only that makes the feast.
